after.PASSED and VALIDATED: proposed to the owner as a paper strategy of its own (rule 14), sized by the risk engine, followed forward on paper; never real money
after.otherwise: reported as it is; nothing changes

spec.data: Binance spot daily klines (data.binance.vision), monthly archives checked against their sha256; a month that cannot be fetched or checked stops the judge, never filled

gates.costs_x2: mean daily net > 0 with the cost doubled
gates.leave_one_coin_out: mean daily net > 0 for BTC alone and for ETH alone
gates.t: t of the mean daily net return of the two-coin book over 2018-01..2024-06 >= the threshold
gates.timing: the book beats holding each coin at its own average exposure: mean daily difference > 0 with t >= 2.0
gates.top_year: no calendar year supplies more than 50% of the total net

spec.holdout_rule: 2024-07..2026-09: mean daily net > 0 with one-sided t >= 1.645, mean daily net > 0 with the cost doubled, and the timing difference's mean > 0
spec.question: does time-series momentum in bitcoin and ether earn a positive net return, and beat holding them at the same average exposure?
spec.rule: exposure for the next day = share of the lookbacks over which the close rose (long or flat); half the capital per coin; a change of exposure pays the cost on the notional traded; a day without its prices is no trade
